title: Release train integration: Runtime 1.21 (kernel auto-selection v2 behind gates + canary coordination + notes)
creator: Connor O'Brien
description:
Goal
- Land kernel auto-selection v2 in Runtime 1.21 behind gates, coordinate hosted canary window(s), and ensure release notes + upgrade notes + operational docs are complete and accurate.

Context
- Kernel auto-selection v2 changes selector decision logic to be aware of model family/architecture, sequence-length regime (prefill/decode), and GPU SKU. This is a performance-sensitive change with tail-latency risk on long-context workloads. We must ship with deterministic behavior, safe fallbacks, and fast rollback levers.

Scope / Deliverables (Release Engineering)
1) Release train readiness (runtime-1.21)
- Confirm v2 changes are behind a hard gate (default OFF) in all environments.
- Verify config plumbing supports: per-region enable, per-model allowlist/denylist, and emergency disable without redeploy.
- Ensure determinism/replay tests are green in CI before canary.

2) Canary orchestration
- Schedule canary window for Hosted pools with SRE + Runtime on point.
- Define rollout stages:
  a) Stage 0: v2 OFF everywhere (baseline metrics captured)
  b) Stage 1: v2 ON for allowlisted models in one low-risk region (small %)
  c) Stage 2: expand to additional regions and SKUs after SLO gates pass
  d) Stage 3: Dedicated pools (opt-in) after Hosted stable
- Establish rollback authority + communication protocol during canary.

3) Release notes + upgrade notes completeness
- Release notes must include:
  - What changed (kernel selection v2)
  - Expected impact (latency/throughput improvements; no API change)
  - Defaults (OFF by default; enabled via control-plane gate)
  - How to override/pin/disable
  - Known limitations / guarded SKUs / driver/CUDA constraints
- Ensure links are included to:
  - Runbook: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/runbooks/kernel-selection-v2-override-and-rollback-runbook.json
  - Dashboard spec: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/kernel-selection-v2-rollout-dashboards.json
  - Release note entry: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/release-notes/runtime-1-21-kernel-auto-selection-v2.json

Acceptance Criteria
- Runtime 1.21 build includes v2 selector code path but ships with gate OFF by default.
- Control plane gate supports: enable by environment/region/model; denylist hot reload works.
- Canary completed with:
  - p95/p99 regression within budgets per SRE gating
  - no correctness regressions (conformance suite clean)
  - selection telemetry visible in dashboards at agreed sampling rate
- Release notes + upgrade notes published and validated by Runtime + SRE oncall reviewers.
- Rollback drill executed (disable v2 for a model/region) and validated via dashboards.

Implementation / Integration Notes
- Primary PRs expected in release candidate:
  - Feature gate/config plumbing: sources/github/redwood/pr-28460-feature-gate-kernel-selection-v2-and-config-plumbing.json
  - Telemetry: sources/github/redwood/pr-28466-add-kernel-selection-telemetry-events.json
  - Determinism tests: sources/github/redwood/pr-28473-selector-determinism-and-replay-tests.json
  - Allowlist/denylist rules: sources/github/redwood/pr-28510-add-model-allowlist-denylist-rules-for-v2-rollout.json
  - Driver guardrail: sources/github/redwood/pr-28495-guardrail-disable-v2-on-known-unstable-driver-versions.json
  - Long-context threshold fix (if needed for canary): sources/github/redwood/pr-28522-fix-regression-in-long-context-prefill-kernel-choice.json
- Observability/dashboard rollouts:
  - Dashboard panels: sources/github/observability-pack/pr-522-kernel-selection-v2-dashboard-panels.json
  - Rollout SLO gates: sources/github/slo-toolkit/pr-284-add-rollout-slo-gates-for-runtime-1-21.json
  - Perf-canary scenarios: sources/github/perf-canary/pr-1932-add-kernel-selection-v2-canary-scenarios.json

Canary Plan (proposed)
- Date: 2026-02-17 (hosted) with 60–90 min active monitoring.
- On point:
  - Release train: Connor O'Brien
  - Runtime kernels: Yuki Sato / Hiro Tanaka
  - SRE: Sean Gallagher / Aisha Bello
  - Observability: Allison Grant
- Rollback triggers (fast path):
  - p99 latency regression > 5% sustained 10m on any allowlisted model
  - error rate regression > 0.2% absolute on selected routes
  - selection distribution anomaly suggesting misclassification on a SKU (sudden shift to fallback kernel)

Open Questions
- Confirm whether Dedicated rollout in 1.21 should remain opt-in only for first train (recommended) or auto-enable for new Dedicated pools after 1 week of hosted stability.
- Confirm telemetry sampling defaults for Hosted vs Dedicated to control cardinality (recommended: 0.5–1% Hosted; lower for large Dedicated pools unless debugging).

Risks / Mitigations
- Risk: Long-context workloads mis-bucketed causing tail spikes.
  - Mitigation: keep denylist ready; keep long-context models opt-in; monitor p99 by seq-length bucket.
- Risk: Metric cardinality increase from per-request candidate sets.
  - Mitigation: restrict candidate set fields to sampled events only; dashboards use normalized SKU + bounded label sets.

Release Checklist
- [x] RC build cut with v2 gate OFF by default
- [x] SLO gates wired into canary runbook
- [x] Dashboards deployed and query reviewed for cardinality
- [x] Runbook reviewed with oncall; rollback drill successful
- [x] Release notes updated; PM-ready language approved

Notes
- Coordinate any customer comms via Marissa Cole if canary triggers an opt-out request for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Any post-release hotfixes (threshold tweaks/denylist updates) must be documented in the known-issues page and referenced in upgrade notes.
